pins.coverageNotes: Versions pinned as of 2026-07-12, all from official vendor sites/forums/GitHub unless flagged. (a) MillMage sectors: CNC-ONLY (routers and mills) - it does NOT do laser. The launch announcement (https://lightburnsoftware.com/blogs/news/millmage-is-here, 2026-02-24) describes it as built specifically for CNC routers ('Directly connect to and control any CNC running GRBL, Smoothieware, or common GRBL variants' / 'generate toolpaths for any CNC that runs standard GCode') and makes no mention of laser functionality; the product page (https://lightburnsoftware.com/products/millmage-core) lists only CNC control targets (GRBL, GRBL M3, GRBL-STM, grblHAL, FluidNC, Smoothieware) plus CAM-only export (Mach3/Mach4, LinuxCNC, UCCNC, Duet/RRF, Masso). Laser remains LightBurn's product. So MillMage competes with KerfDesk's CNC sector only; LightBurn covers the laser sector - KerfDesk's dual laser+CNC coverage spans what LightBurn Software sells as two separate $99+ products. (b) XCS CNC support: no CNC milling/routing support found. XCS drives xTool's laser lineup (diode/CO2/fiber; S1, P2, F1, M1-series hybrids add blade cutting, not milling). The only 'CNC'-branded device XCS operates is the xTool MetalFab 'CNC Cutter' (XCS V2.0+, https://support.xtool.com/article/2108) - but it is a LASER metal-cutting machine (stainless/carbon steel, aluminum, brass, 3-10 mm), not a spindle mill/router. Same conclusion applies to successor xTool Studio: no milling support found. (c) Discontinued/renamed: (1) XCS is discontinued - final release V2.7 (desktop V2.7.22, 2025-06-19); xTool states no further PC/mobile updates and continues development in xTool Studio (V1.7.30, 2026-06-15); products launched after Aug 2025 (P3 onward) are Studio-exclusive (https://support.xtool.com/article/1773, https://support.xtool.com/article/2909) - an audit row for 'XCS' should really target xTool Studio. (2) LightBurn's editions were renamed/restructured effective 2024-10-01 (pre-2.0, so the 2.x line changed nothing structurally): GCode -> Core $99; DSP + Galvo merged -> Pro $199; DSP-only/Galvo-only licenses retired; existing DSP/Galvo holders upgraded to Pro free (https://lightburnsoftware.com/blogs/news/new-lightburn-license-types-and-pricing-coming-oct-1-2024). (3) millmage.com 301-redirects to millmagesoftware.com (observed today; direct fetch of the old domain 404s after redirect). (4) No discontinuation/renaming found for LaserGRBL, Easel, Carbide Create, VCarve, or gSender - though LaserGRBL has had no release since 2025-03-01 (v7.14.1), making it the most stagnant product in the set. Residual unknowns (not guessed, per no-invention rule): exact current stable Carbide Create V8 build number (download page loads it dynamically; last community-confirmed stable promotion was build 836 on 2025-12-05, Intel-Mac pin is build 843, builds 846/851 are 2026 betas); VCarve 12.5 exact release date; an official on-xtool.com price statement for XCS/Studio (free per reseller listing only); Easel exposes no version numbers (SaaS). VCarve $349/$699 USD figures come from a search-engine snippet of Vectric's own purchase page plus two authorized resellers because vectric.com renders prices client-side.
